_comment: package.json declares lodash as a range (^4.17.21) and the add-on ships no lock file, so the vendoring declaration names no single release to fetch and compare the shipped bytes against. A range is legitimate where a lock resolves it - the vendoring guide asks a developer shipping one to commit the lock beside it - so what is reported is the missing lock, not the range. The sibling case, a lock that resolves nothing for the name, is xpi-lock-file-invalid. package.json is exempt from unused-files. Decided offline, no fetch.
